ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with a low macro-level ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels, estimated at approximately 5-8% of the visible fluke area, primarily localized at the distal tips and within linear scars.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous black pigmentation across both lobes. High-contrast, irregular white geometric blobs are mapped to the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. Scattered, thin white linear pixel-paths are distributed across the interior surface, with higher density on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with an acute interior angle and a defined vertical indentation extending towards the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations at the distal tips corresponding to barnacle clusters. The trailing edge towards the notch exhibits a smoother, low-amplitude undulation with occasional small notches.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature of the trailing edge sweeping from the distal tips toward the median notch; convex curvature on the outer lateral margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated at the distal left and right fluke tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks). Distinct parallel lines are visible on the lower-right lobe, with multiple crossing linear marks visible on the central-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation at the distal tips and significant multi-directional rake marks across the entire ventral surface.
